findings.gap: Lever perch clamping screw/nut, separate from pivot and cable adjuster
observed: D04-48 and D15-46/47 exploded drawings show separate transverse holder fastener, vertical lever pivot, threaded cable adjuster and its nut. They are not the four central handlebar-clamp bolts.

D15-64 p108 kit36DK0037 explicitly includes39072504 hexagon boltM6×1,39019811 plainwasher,30191017 nut,DL191014 stud-leverhandle,39118415 NylocM5×0.8 (one each per kit). These names/dimensions are facts of that BM150 document only.

FC-03 original/crop shows bright round fastener heads with cross-like recesses near both perch regions; cropped angle cannot prove whether each belongs to pivot or transverse clamp. MANUAL-13 related-model RH photo also shows a round recessed head adjacent to mirror/perch region.
unknown: Current125HD/RDC clamp fastener drive/nut style and measured length/diameter
Exact assignment of each item in kit36DK0037 to present125HD hardware; bolt M6 and Nyloc M5 must not be mated merely because they share a kit
Hidden nut/underside and final washer stack
max_three_leads: D15-46/47/64: attribution/code and decomposition, relatedBM150 only
MANUAL-13: official related150HD closeup; variant caveat
findings.safe_next_work: A separately attributed related-part clamp screw/nut study is supportable with explicit estimates. Exact125RDC screw/nut remains unconfirmed; do not change existing pivot/adjuster from this evidence.

observed: FC-R07 shows a short dark line leaving LH lever/perch area inboard and running near/below the chrome grip-side handlebar bend before disappearing into dark instrument/visor region. FC-R05 gives opposing oblique context without a clear continuous exposed path.
FC-R06 shows short dark curves around both handlebar sides, but merging black controls/background prevents a reliable long trace.
unknown: Endpoint attachment geometry hidden by boot/perch
Continuous path behind instrument/visor and junction to existing lower sheath
Cable versus adjacent electrical lead where black paths overlap

D04-48/D15-46 decomposition for lever adjuster and boot; no route scale
findings.safe_next_work: Only a very short local departure may be proposed, preserving a cut at its first occlusion. Do not connect to lower cables by inferred continuity.

findings.gap: Front brake upper cable outlet/local segment
observed: FC-03 shows a dark sheath-like line beneath right chrome handlebar heading toward the control/perch at cropped image edge. A sleeve/boot-like transition is visible near that edge, but its precise role cannot be isolated from this crop.
MANUAL-13 related150HD closeup exposes a black cable/boot-like section below RH control running inboard/out of left crop; it documents local topology on that variant, not full currentRDC route.
unknown: Disambiguation of brake sheath from throttle/electrical lines at crossings

Exact boot shape/exit angle and cable travel

findings.safe_next_work: Keep related-manual topology separately labelled. Build no full forward route until ambiguous black lines are distinguished.

D04-48 related assembly and previous DU191003 isolated photo research distinguish grip carrier from outer control; they do not establish measured hidden cam or an upper cable route.
